project.title: local-media-gallery Delivery
project.readme:
# Local Media Gallery Delivery

This Project tracks delivery for `shruggietech/local-media-gallery`. It starts empty; issues and release commitments are added as work is agreed.

- Issues describe independently closeable outcomes with acceptance criteria. Native issue types classify Task, Bug and Feature.
- Status is the sole delivery lifecycle: Backlog, Ready, Specced, In progress, PR review, Release verification and Done.
- Labels own priority, effort, affected areas, platforms and exceptional triage needs. Milestones own release commitments.
- Slice groups compatible issues delivered through one Spec Kit specification, implementation and review cycle. Native relationships own hierarchy and dependencies.
- Closed issues remain available as delivery history. Pull requests and verification evidence support closure.

Backlog captures uncommitted work. Ready is defined and unblocked. Specced has an approved specification. In progress has active implementation. PR review has an open implementation pull request. Release verification is merged and awaiting release evidence. Done satisfies acceptance criteria or has a documented disposition.

Delivery table is the audit view. Delivery board shows the delivery lifecycle. Labels and fields do not replace issue acceptance criteria.
